module origen_219346(
    input CLK,
    input CLR,
    input RST,
    input [8:0] Data9,
    output OUT_ser,
    output CLK_Baud
);

    reg [8:0] Data_Reg;
    reg [3:0] counter;
    reg State;
    reg OUT_ser_reg;
    reg [10:0] Count_Baud;
    reg CLK_Baud_O;

    always @(posedge CLK or posedge CLR) begin
        if (CLR) begin
            Data_Reg <= Data9;
            State <= 1'b1;
            counter <= 4'b1010;
            OUT_ser_reg <= 1'b1;
        end
        else if (RST) begin
            Count_Baud <= 11'd0;
            CLK_Baud_O <= 1'b0;
        end
        else begin
            if (Count_Baud == 11'd1302) begin
                Count_Baud <= 11'd0;
                CLK_Baud_O <= ~CLK_Baud_O;
            end
            else begin
                Count_Baud <= Count_Baud + 1'b1;
            end

            if (State) begin
                if (counter > 0) begin
                    OUT_ser_reg <= Data_Reg[0];
                    Data_Reg <= {1'b0, Data_Reg[8:1]};
                    counter <= counter - 1'b1;
                end
                else begin
                    State <= 1'b0;
                    OUT_ser_reg <= 1'b1;
                end
            end
        end
    end

    assign OUT_ser = OUT_ser_reg;
    assign CLK_Baud = CLK_Baud_O;

endmodule
